# XENON COLLABORATION. XENONnT light-WIMP data release[DS/OL]. GitHub commit a09cd8fd77570dc2095f65f094fbcc114b634dfc [2026-11-06]. https://github.com/XENONnT/light_wimp_data_release/tree/a09cd8fd77570dc2095f65f094fbcc114b634dfc. Associated paper: APRILE E, et al. First Search for Light Dark Matter in the Neutrino Fog with XENONnT[J]. Physical Review Letters, 2025, 134: 111802. DOI:10.1103/PhysRevLett.134.111802; arXiv:2409.17868. Release README DOI:10.5281/zenodo.14522706; this archive is from GitHub, not a byte-verified Zenodo attachment.
# PROJECT_DERIVED. Sum original basis over shadow/S1BDT/S2BDT; trilinear interpolation in (E,Ly,Qy) with nominal official YBe yield curves.
# No extrapolation, renormalization, extra efficiency, exposure, c_i or random sampling. Author source: utils.py::Template.interpolator and default_yield_model.
# 0.51-5keV support; selected local grid for preparation only; finite-grid error and exact 2024-paper applicability require review.
